title: Rating Rule — Restoration Rate After Prior Restorations and Returned Payments (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Rule

For a reinstatement filing on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the restoration rate is set from two records: the filing's own record of transmissions, and the named insured's Cardinal Billing Account ledger.

- Where the filing's record shows a reinstatement transmission within the past 24 months **and** the named insured's billing ledger shows a returned payment within the past 12 months, the restoration rate is the certificate's reinstatement filing fee plus 10.00.
- Where the filing's record shows a reinstatement transmission within the past 24 months **and** the billing ledger shows no returned payment within the past 12 months, the restoration rate is the certificate's reinstatement filing fee plus 5.00.
- Where the filing's record shows no reinstatement transmission within the past 24 months, the restoration rate is the certificate's reinstatement filing fee.

**Windows.** A window of a number of months covers the entries dated less than that many whole months before today, whole months being counted from the entry's date to today. The 24-month window reads the entry dates of reinstatement transmissions on the filing's record; the 12-month window reads the posting dates of returned payments on the Cardinal Billing Account ledger.

## Truth table

| Reinstatement transmission on the filing's record, past 24 months | Returned payment on the billing ledger, past 12 months | Restoration rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Reinstatement filing fee plus 10.00 |
| Yes | No | Reinstatement filing fee plus 5.00 |
| No | Yes | Reinstatement filing fee |
| No | No | Reinstatement filing fee |

## Window boundary (hypothetical dates, today 15 May 2026)

| Entry | Entry date | Whole months to today | Inside the window? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Reinstatement transmission | 16 May 2024 | 23 | Yes (24-month window) |
| Reinstatement transmission | 15 May 2024 | 24 | No |
| Returned payment | 16 May 2025 | 11 | Yes (12-month window) |
| Returned payment | 15 May 2025 | 12 | No |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A certificate whose reinstatement filing fee is taken here as 15.00 shows a reinstatement transmission 9 months ago, and the billing ledger shows a returned payment 3 months ago: restoration rate 15.00 plus 10.00, that is 25.00. With the same history but the returned payment 14 months ago: 15.00 plus 5.00, that is 20.00.
